title: Contract 2: command reader to steerer
description: A target prompt and a ramp length. provisional is true for an early-steering guess; cap is how far the move may go before it is confirmed. strength and without_prompt are optional and come together.

strength.description: Optional. The target is blend(encode(without_prompt), encode(prompt), strength).

without_prompt.description: Optional. The prompt without this change; given together with strength.
